name: Kepgeda's Keening Cauldron
description: The cauldron's ear-splitting keening calls forth spectral claws to assail ears and souls alike.
disable: DC 22 Athletics to tip the cauldron, or DC 20 Occultism or DC 20 Religion (trained) to ward against the cauldron's effects. Any combination of three successful attempts is required to fully disable the haunt. When the haunt is disabled, the coven seeks vengeance.
reset: The haunt becomes inert (resuming its usual screaming) at the end of any round in which no creatures other than Kepgeda remain in her kitchen.
routine: (1 action) The spectral hands scurry about, grabbing at all of Kepgeda's foes in area E13. Each such creature takes 3d6 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 20 Will Saving Throw) as the spectral claws assail them. A creature that takes mental damage from this effect doesn't reduce their frightened value at the end of their next turn.

generalAbilities.name: Crescendo of Claws
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature other than Kepgeda is within 15 feet of the cauldron for at least 1 round

Effect The screams increase in intensity, and a torrent of phantasmal, three-fingered hands with iron claws spews from the cauldron to assail creatures in area E13. Each creature in the room must attempt a DC 23 Will Saving Throw save, with the following results. Kepgeda is immune to the haunt's effects, as she loves the cauldron's screams. The haunt then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature becomes Frightened 1.

Failure The creature becomes Frightened 2 and becomes Off-Guard as long as they remain frightened.

Critical Failure The creature becomes Frightened 3 and is Grabbed as long as they remain frightened.
